name: Message captions
description: A chat thread: each phrase arrives as a message bubble at the bottom, taking turns left and right (or all from one side), and the thread slides up to make room. Give a transcript with --words.

text.label: Text
text.description: what is said; leave empty to caption the transcript as it is. Wrap a word in *stars* for the accent
text.default: Hey, are you there? Yes! Did you see the new captions? They look amazing.

accents.label: Accent words
accents.description: words to put in the accent wherever they are said, comma separated

sides.label: Sides
sides.description: turns: alternate left and right · one: every message from the right

parts.words: the caption words and everything drawn with them
